title: A Unifying Perspective on Language Model Representations: From Filler-Role Structure to Mechanistic Interpretability
abstract: arXiv:2608.29034v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A wide range of methods have been proposed for interpreting language models, delivering important insights into their inner workings. However, different methods and their resulting insights stand in relative isolation: what could the underlying structure of language models be, such that they give rise to all our interpretations? In this work, we propose using Tensor Product Representations (TPRs) as a unifying hypothesis. TPRs give a concrete proposal for how compositional structure could be represented in vector space --- as filler-role bindings. We show, both mathematically and empirically, that TPRs can unify several prior interpretability methods: additive analogies, linear probing, sparse autoencoders, and activation patching. Mathematically, we show that these methods can all be derived from TPRs. translated_title: 语言模型表示的统一视角：从填充-角色结构到机制可解释性
translated_abstract: 人们已经提出了大量用于解释语言模型的方法，这些方法为了解语言模型的内部工作机制提供了重要洞察。然而，不同的方法及其所得出的洞察彼此相对孤立：语言模型的底层结构究竟是什么样的，才能产生我们所有的这些解释？在本工作中，我们提出使用张量积表示（Tensor Product Representations, TPRs）作为统一假设。TPR 为组合结构如何在向量空间中表示提供了一个具体方案——即以填充-角色绑定的形式。我们从数学和实证两方面证明，TPR 可以统一多种先前的可解释性方法：加性类比、线性探针、稀疏自编码器和激活修补。在数学上，我们证明这些方法都可以从 TPR 推导得出；在实证上，我们将这些推导应用于一系列不同的模型——从小型玩具模型到大语言模型——以构建相应的实例。
tldr: 本文提出以张量积表示（TPR）作为统一假设，从数学和实证两方面证明加性类比、线性探针、稀疏自编码器和激活修补等主流可解释性方法均可由 TPR 的填充-角色绑定结构推导而来，从而为语言模型表示提供了一个统一的理论视角。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Tensor Product Representations (TPRs) as a unifying hypothesis, showing both mathematically and empirically that prior interpretability methods—including additive analogies, linear probing, sparse autoencoders, and activation patching—can all be derived from TPR filler-role bindings, offering a unified theoretical perspective on language model representations.
